semantic.justification: Task6764KT extracts the actual SvxStyleBox SetFont/SetFontSize/SetFontStyle operations. Real SfxItemSet slot mapping and inherited/default state determine admission;unknown,disabled and invalid states preserve the recipient. Font name assignment deliberately copies only family/style names,not the other FontItem metadata. Posture precedes weight and each slot is independent. Size uses the absolute item height through an actual caller-owned device conversion and current shell map unit;absence of a shell returns false and no CSS DPI is guessed. These are extracted value operations over the shared Font base,not a partial SvxFont or SvxStyleBox class. Full SetupEntry shell/pool/menu ownership,derived SvxFont behavior,concrete ICU initialization and live widget integration remain unfinished. No whole-module parity promotion. Task6764KT additionally extracts the original SetupEntry base-Font decoration block. Real slot-aware SfxItemSet.GetItem resolves contour,shadow,relief,underline,overline,strikeout and emphasis;each actual item value is read once and assigned to Latin,CJK and CTL font values in source order. Unknown,invalid and disabled items preserve existing prepared values. Source default/local/inherited values and all seven operations are covered through actual pools;real Writer paragraph style tests cover its currently represented underline/strikeout slots. Derived SvxFont case mapping remains separate and is not replaced with text transformation. Full shell/pool/menu SetupEntry,concrete ICU analysis,remaining Writer decoration item mappings/filters and actual WYSIWYG popup paint remain incomplete. The extracted SetupEntry optional-font commit now prepares all three real Font values in source order and replaces each stored optional member only after both name and absolute-size assignment succeed. Missing fonts,unknown/disabled/invalid sizes and absence of a current shell retain previous optional members,including object identities. The actual style pool and device conversion remain caller-owned;this is no replacement pool or renderer.
